t: Minor Parser updates to support the new smithy-generated protocol tests. See `boto/botocore#3247 <https://github.com/boto/botocore/pull/3247>`__ for more details.
Fixes datetime parse error handling for out-of-range and negative timestamps (`#2564 <https://github.com/boto/botocore/issues/2564>`__).
ResponseMetadata will now always be populated, provided the response was able to be parsed into a dict.
